protocol.learning_rule: direct reinforcement: exact dU/dtheta by backpropagation through the realised return path, no critic, no sampled advantage, no discount factor
protocol.observation: 12 five-minute bars x 4 variables + 7 slow variables + 3 causal funding-schedule variables + position one-hot
protocol.actions: three-way target position, straight-through hard selection
protocol.reward: realised account return; risk aversion lives in the objective only
protocol.cost_regime:
Trained and selected at 1 bp one way (2 bp round trip), roughly maker-only
fills at a funded fee tier.  hourly_eq and hourly_v2 were charged 4 bp.
Every sealed-test action path is additionally priced at 4 bp so the
optimistic headline is never reported without its reality check.
protocol.funding: applied at exact Binance settlement timestamps to the position open before them
protocol.selection_rule: median over folds and seeds of the validation total_log_return

selection.rule: median over folds and seeds of the validation total_log_return

zero_cost_gate.criteria: median zero-cost validation log return exceeds zero, exceeds the best simple benchmark, and more than half the runs sit above the 95th percentile of their own matched-turnover circular-shift null
